object_description: A frozen pre-execution instrument design whose target signal, candidate, generator/renderer, gold construction, and evaluator channels may or may not be construct-independent.
qoi: Whether the design is admissible to spend an outcome-bearing epoch without reading the target through a shared author/channel or a statistic that survives a registered null permutation.
scope: proposal-side measurement governance; no scientific authority
assumptions: an undeclared independence obligation is an unrun check, not a pass
author identity and channel identity are explicit design inputs
gold construction must be candidate-independent at the registered evaluator epoch
permutation/shuffle controls are run on development or known-answer fixtures before confirmatory outcome access

strongest_parents.justification: Existing fail-closed pre-execution admissibility gate; this variant adds an orthogonal construct-independence coordinate rather than changing its ceiling semantics.
Existing gate-level falsifiability practice is the strongest internal parent for proving a control can fail rather than merely being declared.
Established parent principle: evaluation/selection reuse can invalidate inference unless the evaluated signal is independent of the selection/adaptation channel.

prior_art_equivalence_map: adaptive holdout reuse and evaluation overfitting
oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-answer fixture instruments provide an exact oracle for whether candidate/gold/channel dependencies were planted. A gate must reject planted shared-channel, same-author, candidate-derived-gold, and permutation-surviving fixtures while admitting clean fixtures; this is a conformance oracle only, not evidence that real instruments are scientifically valid.
minimal_counterexamples: gold label is computed from the candidate prediction
renderer writes an answer-bearing field that the extractor reads
generator and grader are the same unseparated author/process
one obligation is omitted and would otherwise be silently counted as a pass
all four obligations are declared but a planted leak is still admitted
falsifier: On the next 12 instrument closures, designs declaring and satisfying all four obligations do not have a lower construct-defect rate than designs that do not; or a planted construct-dependent known-world fixture is admitted.
same_system_ablation: Same frozen instrument design with exactly one independence obligation removed or violated at a time; evaluator and primary statistic unchanged.
hard_gate_obligations: missing obligation fails closed to CANNOT_CHECK
no verdict grants scientific or method-promotion authority
total_cost_equation: admission_cost = declaration_review + fixture/null-control execution + identity/provenance verification; confirmatory_epoch_cost is excluded because the gate runs before it is spent
novelty_residual: RAKL-specific composition of four pre-execution construct-independence obligations into a fail-closed admission object beside, not inside, the existing ceiling and falsifiability gates.
permitted_publication_claim: At most: the pre-execution admission gate rejects registered construct-dependent fixtures and records undeclared obligations as CANNOT_CHECK. No claim that it improves scientific outcomes until the frozen forward falsifier is executed.
